description: This file contains code for interacting with GitHub's GraphQL API to fetch sponsor data, process it, and update a YAML file in a repository. It includes data models, API request functions, and a main script that automates updating sponsor information and creating a pull request.

classes.name: SponsorEntity
classes.description: Represents a sponsor entity, either a user or an organization, with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: Tier
classes.description: Represents sponsorship tier information, including tier name and monthly price.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerNode
classes.description: Models a node in the sponsorship graph, combining sponsor entity and tier info.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the sponsorship graph with cursor and node.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainer
classes.description: Contains a list of sponsorship edges for a user.

classes.name: SponsorsUser
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with sponsorshipsAsMaintainer data.

classes.name: SponsorsResponseData
classes.description: Wraps the user data returned in the GraphQL response.

classes.name: SponsorsResponse
classes.description: Root model for the GraphQL response, containing data.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for environment settings including tokens, repository info, and timeout.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Sends a POST request to GitHub's GraphQL API with a query and returns the JSON response, handling errors.

methods.name: list[SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge] get_graphql_sponsor_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Retrieves sponsor edges using GraphQL, given optional 'after' cursor for pagination.

methods.name: defaultdict[float,dict[str,SponsorEntity]] get_individual_sponsors( settings: Settings, )
methods.description: Aggregates sponsor data from API, groups sponsors by tiers.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Updates a YAML file with new sponsor content if changed.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching sponsors, updating YAML, and creating a GitHub PR.

ctags.name: get_graphql_response
ctags.signature: ( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )

ctags.name: get_graphql_sponsor_edges
ctags.signature: ( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )

ctags.name: update_content
ctags.pattern: /^def update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any) -> bool:$/
